deployment_blocker.why: The canonical deployment contract deploys the FULL research workspace, not this subset repository.
deployment_blocker.observed_failure: bash CODE/scripts/remote/push-remote.sh -> ValueError: required deployment directory missing or unsafe: <clone>/LITERATURE (exit 1)
deployment_blocker.why_not_bypass: deployment_guard.install() os.replace()s ANALYSIS/CODE/EXPERIMENTS/LITERATURE/PAPER and the top-level files into deploy-backups, so a successful deploy from this subset would REMOVE the VM LITERATURE, PAPER, NOTES.md, DECISIONS.md, AGENTS.md. The guard refuses before any remote mutation, which is the correct fail-closed behaviour. Bypassing push-remote.sh with a manual rsync is also impossible: remote_job.prepare_launch calls deployment_guard.verify_receipt() on every formal run, which re-hashes the deployed workspace against source_tree_sha256, so an out-of-band copy would be refused by design.
deployment_blocker.relation_to_this_repo: The deployed commit 046eea3549... does not exist in this repository history, and the deployed CODE/leo_sim has no pullback.py / recompute.py, so the VM carries a different lineage of the same package layout.

what_was_not_done: No deployment: push-remote.sh refused and the refusal is correct.
No out-of-band copy: it would be refused by verify_receipt at run time.
No formal run on the VM: the two acceptance configs are compiled and authorized for code identity 693796433f..., which is not what the VM has deployed, so a run would be refused (fail-closed).
No reuse of any old authorization.
requirement_to_close: The freeze commit must be checked out ON TOP OF the full research workspace (with LITERATURE/PAPER/AGENTS.md/DECISIONS.md/NOTES.md/LICENSE present) and committed there, so push-remote.sh can stage and verify it.
